transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor (`apps/floor`) was deleted on 2026-10-02. This was PR #2431 under epic #2342 and ADR-049. The external floor replaced it. That is the standalone engine in re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster as Lore, and Lore now reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`. The deletion removed about 17,500 lines and 113 test files, the `floor-helm` subchart, and five ticks that only the old Floor answered. Migration 0095 also removed the `floor` bus subscriber.
